<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[American-led intervention in the Syrian Civil War]], [[International military intervention against ISIL]], [[Barisha raid]]
**[[Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi]], leader of the [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant]], is believed to have died in a [[suicide bombing]] after [[Combined Joint Task Force – Operation Inherent Resolve|U.S.-led coalition]] special forces [[Barisha raid|raid]] targeted positions belonging to [[Huras al-Din]] in Syria's rebel-held [[Idlib Governorate]]. [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] makes a statement at 9:00 AM [[Eastern Daylight Time|EDT]] (1300 [[UTC]]) asserting his death. [https://www.voanews.com/usa/leader-targeted-us-forces-believed-dead-trump-make-statement (Voice of America)] [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-mideast-crisis-baghdadi-group-factbox/baghdadis-death-a-major-blow-to-islamic-state-idUKKBN1X60F3?r (Reuters)]
**[[Abul-Hasan al-Muhajir]], the official spokesman of ISIL, is killed in a second operation near [[Jarabulus]] in northwest Syria. [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2019/10/u-s-targets-senior-isis-leader-in-northwest-syria/ (BNO News)]
**[[France]] is put on high alert due to concerns of ISIL revenge attacks. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-baghdadi-france-vigila/france-on-high-alert-for-revenge-attacks-following-death-of-baghdadi-idUSKBN1X60OD?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**Over 80 [[Taliban]] members are killed in Afghan and U.S. [[airstrike]]s. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/afghan-forces-kill-80-taliban-fighters-officials-191027103220070.html (Al Jazeera)]
**A bomb planted on a foreign tank wounds a soldier at [[Kandahar International Airport]]. The nationality of the military concerned is unknown. [https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/explosion-near-kandahar-airport-in-afghanistan-1.1572165677865 (''Gulf News'')]
**An [[improvised explosive device]] planted by the [[Afghan Taliban|Taliban]] detonates when a child steps on a pressure plate in [[Pashtun_Kot_District|Pashtun Kot]]. The explosion kills five, all children. A sixth child survives but is injured. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-10/27/c_138507298.htm (Xinhua News Agency)]
*[[2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria]], [[Syrian Civil War]]
**Clashes take place between Turkish forces and the [[Syrian Armed Forces|Syrian Army]] in the town of [[Ras al-Ain]], with an undetermined number of casualties. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-syria-security-turkey-clashes/clashes-between-turkish-forces-and-syrian-army-in-north-syria-sana-idUKKBN1X60BA (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*The [[Hong Kong]] [[Economy of Hong Kong|economy]] enters into a [[recession]], as a result of [[2019 Hong Kong protests|continuous protests]] from the past five months. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-hongkong-protests/hong-kong-enters-recession-as-protests-show-no-sign-of-relenting-idUKKBN1X706B?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 California wildfires]]
**Further evacuations are ordered, with 180,000 people now affected. Power companies are scheduled to cut supplies for a million people today, doubling the size of what is already the biggest blackout in [[California]] history in a bid to prevent further fires igniting from damaged electric cables. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-50196185 (BBC News)]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–United States relations]]
**The government of [[North Korea]] says that it is "running out of patience with the U.S." due to "unilateral hostile disarmament demands" and warns that the cordial relationship between [[Kim Jong-un]] and [[Donald Trump]] would not prevent the talks from derailing. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/north-korea-running-patience-us-66555929 (ABC News)]
*Since convening on  6 October, the synod of Catholic bishops from Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, French Guiana, Guyana, Peru, Venezuela, and Suriname gather with [[Pope Francis]] in Rome. According to the bishops, "a deep personal, social and structural conversion" is needed in response to the "unprecedented" environmental and social crisis in the [[Amazon rainforest|Amazon]]. [https://www.catholicnews.com/services/englishnews/2019/caring-for-common-home-requires-deep-ecological-conversion-synod-says.cfm (Catholic News Service)]

;Law and crime
*[[Essex lorry deaths]]
**Three people arrested on suspicion of [[manslaughter in English law|manslaughter]] and conspiracy to [[people trafficking|traffic people]] after 39 deaths in a lorry earlier this week are released on [[police bail]] as [[Essex Police]] continue their investigation. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-essex-50197691 (BBC News)]
*Two men die and ten others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a [[Halloween]] party in [[Greenville, Texas]]. [https://www.nbcdfw.com/news/local/Mass-Shooting-Reported-at-Homecoming-Party-in-Greenville-Outside-of-Dallas-563934821.html (KXAS-TV)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Chilean protests]]
**[[Chile|Chilean]] [[President of Chile|President]] [[Sebastián Piñera]] fires all sitting ministers of his government. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-50197673 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 Argentine general election]]
**[[Argentina|Argentinian]] voters go to the polls to elect a new [[President of Argentina|president]]. Though the margin is lower than what [[Opinion polling for the 2019 Argentine general election|opinion polls]] predicted, [[Alberto Fernández]] of the left-wing [[Justicialist Party]] beats incumbent [[Mauricio Macri]] of the center-right [[Republican Proposal]]. Macri becomes the first president in Argentinian history to lose his reelection bid. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/argentina-rejects-austerity-elect-alberto-fernandez-president-191028004353278.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2018–19 Iraqi protests]], [[October 2019 Iraqi protests]]
**Several universities and schools shut down as many students join the protests across [[Iraq]]. Thousands continue to participate in spite of the violent crackdowns from the previous days. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/iraqi-students-join-thousands-ongoing-anti-gov-protests-191027201126667.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2019–20 Lebanese protests]]
**Nearly 170,000 protestors form a 105 mile (170 km) [[human chain (politics)|human chain]] running from [[Tyre, Lebanon|Tyre]] to [[Tripoli, Lebanon|Tripoli]] to symbolize their solidarity. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/lebanon-protesters-form-human-chain-country-191027113442407.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/27/middleeast/lebanon-human-chain-trnd/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2019 Omani general election]]
**Citizens of [[Oman]] vote for the members of the country's [[Consultative Assembly (Oman)|Consultative Assembly]]. [https://timesofoman.com/article/2131951/Oman/Government/We-voted-for-our-country (''Times of Oman'')]
*[[2019 Uruguayan general election]]
**People in [[Uruguay]] vote for their next [[President of Uruguay|president]] and the members of the country's [[Senate of Uruguay|senate]] and [[Chamber of Representatives of Uruguay|Chamber of Representatives]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-uruguay-election/uruguay-heads-to-the-polls-with-tight-race-expected-idUSKBN1X60JI (Reuters)] 
*[[2019 Catalan protests]]
**In [[Barcelona]], 80,000 demonstrators take to the streets in protest of the [[Catalan independence movement|Independent politics]] of the Catalan government and the violence of the last weeks' [[2019 Catalan protests|pro-independence protests]], and for the unity and democracy of Spain. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia/catalonia-divided-barcelona-hosts-unionist-rally-a-day-after-separatist-march-idUSKBN1X60K0 (Reuters)]
*[[Politics of Belgium]]
**[[Sophie Wilmès]] becomes the first female [[Prime Minister of Belgium]], succeeding [[Charles Michel]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/28/belgium-first-female-pm-sophie-wilmes (''The Guardian'')]
*[[United States Democratic Party|U.S. Democratic]] [[United States Congress|Congresswoman]] [[Katie Hill (politician)|Katie Hill]] of [[California]] announces her resignation days after admitting to having a relationship with a campaign staffer before coming into office. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/27/politics/katie-hill-announces-resignation/index.html (CNN)]

;Science and technology
*The uncrewed [[Boeing X-37|Boeing X-37B]] spacecraft returns to [[Earth]] after spending a record 780 days in orbit. The nature of the X-37B's mission remains [[classified information]]. [https://www.af.mil/News/Article-Display/Article/1999734/x-37b-breaks-record-lands-after-780-days-in-orbit/ (United States Air Force)] [https://www.space.com/x-37b-space-plane-otv5-lands-after-780-days.html (Space)]

;Sports
* In [[golf]], [[Tiger Woods]] wins the inaugural [[Zozo Championship]] in Japan by three shots over [[Hideki Matsuyama]] for his 82nd career [[PGA Tour]] title, tying him with [[Sam Snead]] atop the [[List of golfers with most PGA Tour wins|all-time list]]. [https://www.espn.com/golf/story/_/id/27945812/tiger-woods-takes-82nd-pga-tour-title-tying-sam-snead-atop-list (ESPN)]
